crime: Before any disaster had struck, {WITCH_NAME}'s family made her empty and repack her school bag before leaving home while reciting a fixed list of warnings. Missing one meant starting over. None of them had ever come true.

During evening free time in prison, {WITCH_NAME} regularly played pool with another girl in the recreation room. {WITCH_NAME} checked the rack twice before every game, then kept an accurate record of every shot. Her partner accepted the routine because she wanted a patient opponent and an accurate record of every practice game.

One evening, {WITCH_NAME} restarted the rack check. Before the second check was finished, her partner scattered the balls and said she had followed the checks and warnings only to preserve their friendship. She would not do it anymore.

One family warning said that anyone who whistled indoors after the evening meal would lose her voice the next time the whistler tried to call out, until sunrise. Her partner repeated it before {WITCH_NAME} and a third girl, then whistled to reject it. {WITCH_NAME} watched.

{WITCH_NAME}'s partner and the third girl went to the library. {WITCH_NAME} followed and asked to speak with her partner. The third girl browsed elsewhere as the pair moved between shelves beyond her sight, and did not watch the entrance continuously.

{WITCH_NAME} left a short time later. She later claimed that her partner had still been alive and anyone could have entered afterward. The third girl had remained close enough to hear a call, but heard none.

The third girl found her partner strangled between the shelves. The dead girl was clutching a piece torn from her pool partner's distinctive prison clothes. Those clothes had a fresh tear that matched the piece.

The third girl had seen the victim whistle while {WITCH_NAME} watched, and the absence of any call matched the warning's stated consequence. The torn cloth showed that {WITCH_NAME} had fought with the victim and disproved her story about a later attacker. After watching her partner whistle, {WITCH_NAME} had made the warning come true, followed her partner between the shelves, and strangled the victim while the warning kept the victim from calling for help.
fields.epitaph: The last safe mark fell in the shape of the disaster she inherited.
execution: A massive solid iron check mark descends toward her on the execution stand. Its long stroke pins her shoulders and chest against the stand. The machine keeps pressing the iron down until her ribs collapse, her breathing stops, and she dies.

magic.name: Grandmother's Law
magic.text: After seeing someone break one of her family's fixed warnings, she can make its stated misfortune happen to that person.
